description: No mechanism exists to respond to data subject requests without undue delay and within the required one-month timeframe. Controllers must be able to receive, process, and respond to rights requests.
applicability: Applicable to all data subject rights request handling. Includes access requests, erasure requests, and all other rights under Articles 15-22.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of request handling procedures, response tracking systems, and historical response times. Verify ability to meet one-month deadline.
